source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why must you evaluate a cheaper execution model even if a more capable model helped write the skill?

options.text: Authoring quality does not establish execution quality
options.feedback: A well-developed procedure may help a cheaper model, but only tested results show whether it meets your requirements.

options.text: The cheaper model should be rejected because another model wrote its instructions
options.feedback: The proposed strategy may work. Evaluation determines adequacy rather than assuming failure from model differences.

options.text: A stronger authoring model automatically installs all execution dependencies
options.feedback: Developing instructions does not establish that required software or access exists in the execution environment.

options.text: The authoring model permanently transfers its own abilities into the cheaper model
options.feedback: A skill supplies guidance; it does not transfer the authoring model's underlying capabilities into another model.
